## Description

This release makes inbound message handling concurrent after the initialization handshake, adds SSE heartbeats and elicitation schema validation, and fixes several Streamable HTTP response and session-lifecycle bugs.

### Breaking Changes

**Concurrent inbound dispatch** by @devcrocod in [#884](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/884)

Inbound messages were processed serially on the transport read loop, so one slow or peer-awaiting handler (sampling, elicitation, roots) blocked every later message on the connection, including the responses and `notifications/cancelled` those handlers depend on. After the handshake, handlers may now run concurrently; processing stays serial during initialization.

- `ProtocolOptions` / `ClientOptions` / `ServerOptions` gain a `handlerCoroutineContext` parameter (defaults to `Dispatchers.Default`). Concurrency is bounded internally; there is no opt-out flag by design.
- `RequestHandlerExtra` is now a `CoroutineContext.Element` and is no longer user-constructible. It exposes `requestId`, `method`, `sendRequest`, and `sendNotification`, and can be read inside a handler via the new `currentRequestHandlerExtra()`.

```diff
- val extra = RequestHandlerExtra()
+ val extra = currentRequestHandlerExtra()
```

**Duplicate feature names are rejected at registration** by @devcrocod in [#883](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/883)

`addTool`/`addPrompt`/`addResource`/`addResourceTemplate` silently replaced an existing entry and emitted a spurious `list_changed` notification. They now throw `IllegalArgumentException` and leave the existing registration intact. The batch variants (`addTools`/`addPrompts`/`addResources`) are all-or-nothing. To replace a feature, remove it first.

```diff
- server.addTool(name = "search", ...)  // silently overwrote
+ server.removeTool("search")
+ server.addTool(name = "search", ...)
```

**`eventStore` removed from `mcpStatelessStreamableHttp`** by @devcrocod in [#909](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/909)

The parameter was never read or written: a stateless endpoint answers `GET` with `405`, so no stream exists to store or replay events on. The old overload is retained at `DeprecationLevel.ERROR` with a `ReplaceWith` migration hint. Use `mcpStreamableHttp` when you need resumability.

```diff
  application.mcpStatelessStreamableHttp(
      path = "/mcp",
-     eventStore = myEventStore,
  ) { server }
```

### Features

- Optional SSE heartbeats for Streamable HTTP servers via `mcpStreamableHttp(sseHeartbeatConfig = { ... })`, keeping long-lived streams alive against clients that disconnect on idle. Heartbeats stay off by default, by @UnscientificJsZhai in [#761](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/761)
- Accepted form-mode elicitation content is now validated against `requestedSchema`; a mismatch fails `createElicitation` with `McpException` (`INVALID_PARAMS`) instead of reaching server code unchecked, by @rea9r in [#896](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/896)
- The Streamable HTTP client now sends the standard `Mcp-Method` and `Mcp-Name` POST headers, by @AndreKalberer in [#894](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/894)

### Fixed

- Stateless Streamable HTTP now closes its per-request session, fixing unbounded growth of the session registry and notification subscriptions, by @KlyneChrysler in [#872](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/872)
- Streamable HTTP responses keep their status and body when the client accepts only `text/event-stream`, by @devcrocod in [#911](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/911)
- The `Accept` header is parsed as media ranges, so clients sending `*/*` or `application/*` are matched correctly, by @devcrocod in [#912](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/912)
- Malformed request params are reported as `Invalid params` (`-32602`) instead of `Internal error`, by @jstar0 in [#886](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/886)
- Duplicate `initialize` errors preserve the JSON-RPC request id, by @jstar0 in [#868](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/868)
- Connection teardown clears the recently-cancelled request id buffer, by @devcrocod in [#892](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/892)

### Maintenance

- Create the server session before connecting the client in tests, avoiding a `ChannelTransport` startup race, by @devcrocod in [#885](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/885)

### Dependencies

- Ktor to v3.5.1 in [#832](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/832)

- detekt-gradle-plugin to v2.0.0-alpha.5 in [#849](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/849)

- Sample projects updated to Kotlin 2.4.x, Ktor BOM 3.5.1, and mcp-kotlin 0.14.0 in [#819](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/819), [#822](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/822), [#825](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/825), [#827](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/827), [#829](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/829), [#859](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/859), [#860](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/860), [#861](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/861), [#862](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/862), [#863](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/863), [#875](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/875), [#876](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/876), [#877](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/877), [#878](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/878), [#879](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/879), [#899](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/899)

## Description

Adds wire-level support for SEP-1686 Tasks and SEP-1036 URL Mode Elicitation.

### Breaking Changes

These changes are **source-compatible** (existing Kotlin code compiles unchanged thanks to default values) but **binary-incompatible** — recompile against 0.14.0, and update any Java or fully-positional call sites.

**`SseServerTransport` constructor and the `mcp { }` Ktor server extensions gained a request-body-size limit** by @devcrocod in [#839](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/839)

A new `maxRequestBodySize` parameter (default applied) was added, changing the binary signatures.

```diff
- SseServerTransport(endpoint, session)
+ SseServerTransport(endpoint, session, maxRequestBodySize = DEFAULT_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_SIZE)
```

**`StreamableHttpClientTransport` constructor gained an inline SSE event-size limit** by @devcrocod in [#841](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/841)

A new `maxInlineSseEventSize` parameter was inserted before `requestBuilder`. Trailing-lambda Kotlin calls are unaffected; positional callers must adjust.

**`CallToolRequestParams` and `CreateMessageRequestParams` gained a `task` field** by @devcrocod in [#844](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/844)

Added as part of SEP-1686 Tasks; the generated `copy()`/`componentN()` signatures shifted, so dependents must recompile.

### Features

- Add SEP-1686 Tasks wire-level types (`TaskMetadata`, `task` on tool-call and sampling params) by @devcrocod in [#844](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/844)
- Add SEP-1036 URL Mode Elicitation, including `UrlElicitationRequiredException`, `UrlElicitationRequiredData`, and the `Elicitation.supportsUrl` capability flag by @devcrocod in [#843](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/843)

### Fixed

- Bound incoming HTTP POST body size in the SSE and Streamable HTTP server transports to prevent memory exhaustion from oversized requests by @devcrocod in [#839](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/839)
- Bound the size of a single inline SSE event parsed from a POST response in `StreamableHttpClientTransport` by @devcrocod in [#841](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/841)
- Validate `Origin` against localhost by default in DNS rebinding protection, rejecting requests with a valid `Host` but hostile or `null` `Origin` by @devcrocod in [#840](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/840)
- Gate `completion/complete` on the server's `completions` capability instead of `prompts` by @rea9r in [#846](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/846)
- Close stdio read sources during shutdown so `StdioClientTransport.close()` no longer hangs on a blocked read by @jstar0 in [#798](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/798)
- Polish SEP-1577 sampling handling — reject empty sampling content and emit an explicit error when `tool_use` is not followed by `tool_result` by @MukundaKatta in [#765](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/765)

### Dependencies

- kotlinx-io-core to v0.9.1 in [#855](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/855)
- kotlinx-collections-immutable to v0.5.0 in [#833](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/833)
- Gradle wrapper to v9.6.1 in [#851](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/851), [#856](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/856)
- gradle-maven-publish-plugin to v0.37.0 in [#848](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/848)
- actions/checkout to v7 in [#852](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/852)
- Kotest group updates in [#847](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/847)
- MockK to v1.14.11 in [#792](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/792)
- Logback to v1.5.37 in [#794](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/794), [#857](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/857)
- Infrastructure group updates in [#797](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/797)
- Sample and integration-test dependency bumps (mcp-kotlin/kotlin-sdk-client to 0.13.0, anthropic-java to 2.40.1, hono, esbuild, tsx, @types/node) in [#795](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/795), [#799](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/799), [#818](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/818), [#820](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/820), [#821](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/821), [#823](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/823), [#824](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/824), [#826](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/826), [#828](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/828), [#831](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/831), [#837](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/837), [#853](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/853), [#854](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/854), [#864](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/864), [#865](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/865)

### New Contributors

## Description

Adds a `tasks` capability and a typed `elicitation` capability, hardens transport lifecycle, dispatchers, and back-pressure, and enables DNS rebinding protection by default.

### Breaking Changes

**Typed `elicitation` capability and new `tasks` capability** by @devcrocod in [#732](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/732)

`ClientCapabilities.elicitation` is now a typed `ClientCapabilities.Elicitation` (`form`, `url`) instead of a raw `JsonObject?`, and both `ClientCapabilities` and `ServerCapabilities` gained a typed `tasks` capability. The constructors of both types changed and are binary-incompatible; recompilation is required.

**Transport handlers now run on `Dispatchers.Default`** by @devcrocod in [#778](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/778)

Handlers moved from `Dispatchers.IO` to `Dispatchers.Default` (override via `handlerDispatcher`), `send()` now suspends under back-pressure instead of buffering unbounded, and the two-argument `StdioServerTransport(input, output)` constructor is deprecated in favor of the builder-lambda form. Also fixes a `start()`/`close()` race, consistent `CancellationException` propagation, and an input-`Source` leak (closes #573, #574, #708).

**DNS rebinding protection enabled by default** by @devcrocod in [#659](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/659)

`enableDnsRebindingProtection` now defaults to `true` on `mcpStreamableHttp`/`mcpStatelessStreamableHttp`, and the `Route.mcp()` / `Application.mcp()` overloads gained `enableDnsRebindingProtection`, `allowedHosts`, and `allowedOrigins` parameters (binary-incompatible on JVM). Only `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, and `[::1]` are allowed by default; opt out with `enableDnsRebindingProtection = false`. The `Configuration.enableDnsRebindingProtection`, `.allowedHosts`, and `.allowedOrigins` properties are deprecated in favor of the new `DnsRebindingProtection` plugin.

### Features

- Add a `tasks` capability (`list`, `cancel`, and per-request augmentation for sampling and elicitation) on `ClientCapabilities` and `ServerCapabilities`, with assertions for `tasks/*` and `notifications/tasks/status` enforced by `Client` and `ServerSession` by @devcrocod in [#732](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/732)
- Configurable `handlerDispatcher` and `ioDispatcher`, plus an optional caller-supplied `CoroutineScope`, on transports by @devcrocod in [#778](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/778)

### Fixed

- Fire `onClose` callbacks on `SseClientTransport` when the SSE session ends — whether closed gracefully or terminated by an error — matching the other client transports by @jskjw157 in [#738](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/738)

### Security

- Enable DNS rebinding protection by default across all HTTP transports, including the SSE endpoints that previously had none (see Breaking Changes for migration) by @devcrocod in [#659](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/659)
- Cap a single stdio JSON-RPC frame at 16 MiB, throwing the new `TooLongFrameException` instead of buffering unbounded when a peer never sends a newline terminator by @devcrocod in [6e6f805](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/commit/6e6f80512fb8fcc9f3c031cfd693ccbcf9c4aaab)

### Maintenance

- Remove the test-only `dev.mokksy:mokksy` dependency in favor of `MockEngine` and `embeddedServer` by @devcrocod in [#754](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/754)

### Dependencies

- Ktor to v3.4.3 in [#785](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/785)
- kotlinx.coroutines to v1.11.0 in [#760](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/760)
- kotlin-logging to v8.0.03 in [#752](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/752), [#783](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/783)
- 24 further Dependabot updates across sample projects, TypeScript conformance-test fixtures, and build/test tooling (JUnit, slf4j-simple, Gradle wrapper, anthropic-java)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/compare/0.12.0...0.13.0

## Description

Adds sampling-with-tools per SEP-1577, JSON Schema dialect declaration on tool schemas, server-side tool name validation, and capability extensions; fixes SSE reconnect on the same session and stops swallowing `CancellationException`.

### Breaking Changes

**Sampling messages can carry tool calls and results (SEP-1577)** by @devcrocod in [#718](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/718)

`SamplingMessage.content` is now typed as a new `SamplingMessageContent` supertype, with `MediaContent` (text/image/audio), `ToolUseContent`, and `ToolResultContent` as variants. `MediaContent` still exists and now extends `SamplingMessageContent`, so most source code that constructs sampling messages compiles unchanged — but the binary signatures of `SamplingMessage`, `CreateMessageResult`, and related types have changed. `ClientCapabilities.sampling` is also now a typed `Sampling` object instead of a raw `JsonObject`. Recompilation is required; consumers reading `sampling` as `JsonObject` must migrate to the typed accessors.

**`watchosX64` and `tvosX64` Kotlin/Native targets removed** by @devcrocod in [#727](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/727)

These targets have been deprecated upstream. Migrate to the corresponding ARM/simulator targets (`watchosArm64`, `watchosSimulatorArm64`, `tvosArm64`, `tvosSimulatorArm64`).

### Features

- Add `$schema` field to `ToolSchema`, declaring JSON Schema 2020-12 as the default dialect (SEP-1613) by @devcrocod in [#696](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/696)
- Validate tool names at registration time on the server, following the MCP tool naming standard (SEP-986) by @devcrocod in [#695](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/695)
- Add `extensions` field to `ClientCapabilities` and `ServerCapabilities` for advertising supported MCP extensions during the initialize handshake by @eritscher in [#678](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/678)

### Fixed

- Validate the `mcp-protocol-version` HTTP header on initialization requests and correct `DEFAULT_NEGOTIATED_PROTOCOL_VERSION` to match the spec by @devcrocod in [#697](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/697)
- Propagate `CancellationException` instead of logging it as an error by @devcrocod in [#706](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/706)
- Evict stale GET SSE stream mapping on reconnect so a new GET on the same session is no longer silently rejected by the leftover entry from the previous stream by @amr in [#716](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/716)

### Maintenance

- Add `kotlinlang` MCP server sample with `search` and `get_page` tools by @devcrocod in [#713](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/713)
- Migrate detekt to a `buildSrc` convention plugin with a fully explicit, version-locked YAML config by @devcrocod in [#729](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/729)
- Add Streamable HTTP integration tests for pagination, bad-request handling, and logging by @jskjw157 in [#613](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/613)
- Remove unused OpenAPI Generator plugin and configuration by @devcrocod in [#683](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/683)
- Remove Codecov configuration in favor of kover by @devcrocod in [#691](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/691)
- Remove redundant JUnit XML report configuration by @devcrocod in [#728](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/728)
- Remove IDEA files tied to the incompatible detekt IDE plugin by @devcrocod in [#714](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/714)
- Add Node.js setup to the release workflow so TypeScript integration tests run on macOS runners by @devcrocod in [#684](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/684)

### Dependencies

- Kotlin to v2.3.21 in [#704](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/704), [#723](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/723)
- kotlinx.serialization-json to v1.11.0 in [#687](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/687)

### New Contributors

- @eritscher made their first contribution in [#678](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/678)
- @amr made their first contribution in [#716](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/716)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/compare/0.11.1...0.12.0

### Description

Fixes an SSE stream crash on Netty when clients connect to the Streamable HTTP GET endpoint.

### Fixed

- Fixed GET SSE stream crash on Netty in Streamable HTTP where `appendSseHeaders()` was called after response headers were already committed, causing `UnsupportedOperationException` and client retry loops by @devcrocod in [#681](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/681)

### Dependencies

- mcp-kotlin to v0.11.0 in [#672](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/672), [#673](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/673), [#675](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/675), [#676](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/676)
- Ktor BOM to v3.3.3 in [#650](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/650), [#653](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/653), [#656](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/656)

Adds URL-mode elicitation with typed schema definitions, configurable server payload size limits, and upgrades core dependencies to Kotlin 2.3.

## Breaking Changes

**`ElicitRequestParams` is now a sealed interface** by @devcrocod in [#660](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/660)

Restructured to support both form-based and URL-based elicitation modes per the MCP specification. `ElicitRequestParams` changed from a `data class` to a `sealed interface` with two variants: `ElicitRequestFormParams` and `ElicitRequestUrlParams`. A deprecated factory function preserves source compatibility for existing calls.

```diff
- val params = ElicitRequestParams(message = "...", requestedSchema = schema)
+ val params = ElicitRequestFormParams(message = "...", requestedSchema = schema)
```

**`RequestedSchema.properties` type changed** by @devcrocod in [#660](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/660)

Changed from `JsonObject` to `Map<String, PrimitiveSchemaDefinition>` for type safety.

**`macosX64` target removed** by @devcrocod in [#625](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/625)

The `macosX64` native target was removed following its deprecation in Kotlin 2.2 and scheduled removal in Kotlin 2.3. Use `macosArm64` instead.

## Features

- URL-mode elicitation and typed `PrimitiveSchemaDefinition` hierarchy aligned with MCP specification by @devcrocod in [#660](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/660)
- Configurable max request payload size for `StreamableHttpServerTransport` via `Configuration.maxRequestBodySize` by @jskjw157 in [#646](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/646)
- Auto-install `ContentNegotiation` with `McpJson` in `mcp()`, `mcpStreamableHttp()`, and `mcpStatelessStreamableHttp()` — users no longer need to configure JSON serialization manually (#664) by @kpavlov in          
  [#665](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/665) 
- `notifications/elicitation/complete` notification from server to client for out-of-band elicitation completion by
  @devcrocod in [#667](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/667)

## Fixed

- Elicitation schema defaults are now applied for missing fields in client responses by @devcrocod in [#661](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/661)
- Duplicate `initialize` requests are now rejected with `INVALID_REQUEST` error by @devcrocod in [#624](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/kotlin-sdk/pull/624)
